         CASE WHEN octet_length(node_ids_json::text)<=65536 THEN node_ids_json ELSE NULL END AS ids
         FROM "workflow_admit_3606596f_5922_419a_8b02_f0aa32b85219".workflow_node_passes WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND run_id=$2 AND operation_id=$3

     WHERE tenant_id=$6 AND run_id=$7 AND revision=$8
